g.text: Well-instructed disciple of noble ones discerns
Mind released through lack of clinging
Fading of passion leads to awareness-release
Fading of ignorance leads to discernment-release
With release, there is the knowledge, 'Released'
Unarisen passion does not arise / arisen passion is abandoned
Unarisen aversion does not arise / arisen aversion is abandoned (via goodwill)
Unarisen delusion does not arise / arisen delusion is abandoned
Attends periodically to Concentration, Uplifted Energy, Equanimity
If attends solely to Uplifted Energy
